profile.headline: Software Engineer @ PwC
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Amber — an early-career software developer with a passion for building user-focused solutions and exploring the possibilities of AI, automation, and data-driven technology.

Through professional and academic projects, I’ve gained hands-on experience in full-stack development, data analytics, and machine learning — and I’m excited to keep applying and growing these skills in real-world environments.

I’m eager to keep learning, building, and collaborating with others who believe in using technology to drive positive change. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with engineering managers to migrate a document processing application from ABBYY to Azure Document Intelligence Studio
 • Utilized Git to resolve bugs and optimize product performance of C# code in Visual Studio Code
 • Developed a custom neural model to extract information from documents and stored the values in a SQL database

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Transformed raw data into usable formats through data manipulation and cleaning techniques
• Developed data visualizations (e.g., charts, graphs) to effectively convey data stories
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define data requirements and project objectives

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Modified Python code with input parameters to enhance the model's overall performance
• Entered the model within community league races to compare with similar designs
•  Presented research at the Louisiana Academy of Sciences and won Best Undergraduate Poster Presentation

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Managed accounts, perform, bookkeeping, and answer phone lines. 
•  Scheduled 10+ appointments daily via email and maintained calendars. 
•  Created and maintained filing systems, both electronic and physical.

positions.title: Google Product Inclusion and Equity Summit Scholar
positions.description:
• Selected as one of 60 scholars from a pool of 1,500+ applicants for Google's Product Inclusion & Equity Summit
• Immersed in a two-day intensive exploring strategies to create inclusive and equitable products through expert-led sessions and collaborative projects

positions.title: START Intern
positions.description:
• Leveraged AI to analyze and visualize data from an educational company serving over 6 million users
• Utilized Power Automate to develop a workflow to filter out inconclusive data
• Developed data visualizations with Power BI to showcase areas for efficiency improvement by 6%
• Shadow software engineers and data scientists to conceptualize daily tasks for projects
• Establish a fundamental knowledge of AI through the practice of internal processes and procedures

positions.title: Black and Hispanic Project Management Summit
Hackathon Competitor
positions.description:
• Engaged in a business case study to strengthen leadership and technical skills
•  Developed an application with Visual Studios to increase fan engagement for NFL game days with AR and VR technologies
•  Presented a business plan for judges to rate solution effectiveness

positions.title: Student Extern
positions.description:
• Completed Automation Anywhere Training in preparation for the challenge to develop foundational automation skills
• Collaborated with a team of 4 students to automate a business process using RPA and other scripting languages
• Delivered a presentation to RSM Technical Recruiters that placed in the top 3 for showcasing the efficiency of the software bot

certifications.name: MIT IDSS - Data Science Machine Learning Program
certifications.title: MIT IDSS - Data Science Machine Learning Program

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Executed a successful blanket drive by raising over $500 to purchase blankets for the elderly residing in nursing homes in Lincoln Parish.
• Coached children with disabilities to perform in the 2021 Buddy Ball 
Tournament.
• Donated presents to low-income families during the holiday season.

• Packaged 3000 food bags for children facing food insecurity
• Wrote handwritten encouragement cards for kids
